title: fissile check output
description: `fissile check --format json` (FS-004-check-audit.1, GOAL-004-token-thrift.1): a flat array of standing finding records, one per violation, sorted deterministically. An empty array means a clean check. Staged and base runs (`--staged`, `--base <ref>`, FS-004-check-audit.1.5) add soft-edit provenance to soft records; only base records carry `soft_edit_source` and `soft_edit_before_base`.
